output.answer_markdown: Fiscal 2023 net sales were in line with the prior year on a comparable constant currency basis [1], largely reflecting price/mix benefits of approximately 3% [2]. Reported net sales rose 1%, which included price increases of approximately $775 million from passing through higher raw material costs [3]. The material does not give a real sales change that also excludes passthrough costs and one-off items, so that figure cannot be stated.
